title: General Epistles and Revelation
description: A study of Hebrews, James, 1-2 Peter, 1-3 John, Jude and Revelation. Students examine each book's setting, structure and theology - Christ's superior priesthood and the warning passages in Hebrews, faith and works in James, suffering and hope in 1 Peter, false teaching in 2 Peter and Jude, assurance and love in John's letters - and study Revelation's genre, symbolism, major interpretive schools and message of the Lamb's victory.

lessons.paper_prompt: Write a 1,500-2,000 word exegetical paper on ONE passage from Hebrews, the General Epistles or Revelation (8-20 verses).
